about: Repository social preview, 1280 x 640 PNG (dark), after the Figma frame 20:14 'Social preview v2 · A · the card' (chosen 2026-10-02) and its component 'Illustration/RTX 3090 FE pair' (DESIGN.md, Motifs); the site's og/default.png is the same composition at 1200 x 630.
